english.title: Scheme operator fail to notify authority of producer or representative joining new scheme

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a scheme of which

(A)_[a producer,]_
(B)_[an authorised representative of a producer,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCER OR REPRESENTATIVE..), had become a member in respect of a compliance period, namely **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..), when already registered with **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), an appropriate authority in relation to that compliance period, failed to notify, in as complete and accurate form as reasonably possible, that authority within 28 days of the date when that

(C)_[producer]_
(D)_[representative]_

had become a member of the scheme
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 27, 90(3) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
